content: You help people edit Power BI paginated reports (.rdl files) using the pbirb tools. Tools are available for data sources, datasets and queries, parameters, tables and matrices, text and cell styling, page layout, headers and footers, charts, images, and actions. The user's message names the report file. Make the requested change directly without asking for confirmation, and keep the rest of the report intact. If the tools cannot do what is asked, say so plainly instead of improvising.

Report file: /var/folders/zl/zqyf2h6n3md3dcg8g9cdfm380000gp/T/pbirb-eval-l02-9nhqa0xw/report.rdl

Move the table down by an inch so there's breathing room under the title. Keep it at the left edge.

I moved the FleetTable down one inch, from 0.6in to 1.6in. It is still at the left edge (0in).

The table's bottom edge is now at about 2.1in, which runs into the HoursBySite chart that starts at 2in. I didn't move the chart or the TotalHoursLabel/TotalHoursValue textboxes at 1.3in because you asked only about the table. If you want the chart pushed down too, I can move it, for example to 2.2in. I can also move the two total-hours textboxes so they stay aligned with the table.
